prompts: Create an unframed transparent 2D pixel RPG sprite atlas for the Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King. Image 1 is the current sprite/style, image 2 confirms the pale-green huge round belly with orange swirl, short paws, pointed leaf ears, royal blue throat flower and deep green fronds, image 3 shows that the throat flower and fin tips turn hot orange after gulping fruit. Preserve the same bulky reptilian character in six isolated right-facing poses, 3 columns x 2 rows. Top left: sweeping layered leaf tail, weight planted low; top middle: spreading short limbs, deep crouch coiling for jump; top right: belly-first leap, feet lifted, arms open. Bottom left: broad grounded belly-first splat, arms and two feet readable; bottom middle: lifting head with cheeks puffed, conserved orange flame-charged flower and blue removed just on the lit elements; bottom right: glowing orange fire-fruit, a single round seed with three pointed orange bracts, no flame trail. Entire silhouette within each cell with generous blank gutters, alpha transparent, do not draw any frame, border, cell lines, extra decorations, floor, text, particles, or shadows. True pixel clusters and dark contours.

Create an original wide 16:9 pixel RPG background for a Natlan ravine arena. The supplied in-game image is a reference for dark reddish rock walls, green foot-level clearing and a soft shaft of daylight. Flat grassy soil extends continuously across the bottom quarter, framed in the distance by rust-colored canyon columns, a narrow blue-white waterfall behind the scene, mossy ledges, hanging vines and occasional tiny blue plants. Lower scene colors dark enough to separate a pale green giant and orange impact warnings. Side-on view, exploration-game pixel clusters and lighting. No characters, text, logos, borders, combat effects, or objects blocking the arena.

references.use: blue crest, round belly and ravine materials
orange fruit-charged crest and leaf tips

notes: Combat poses face right. The existing left-facing idle is mirrored to match.
The fruit is a visual element and is removed upon impact. Original artwork color is preserved in PNG mode.
No matching 3D model was verified. Ravine art is a temporary lab bitmap.
